findings.one_line: The directional identity (30) is not implied by integration by parts: for the joint score S_D, conditioning on O does not make E[S_D|O] zero, so subtracting E[m_{x,h}(O)|O] leaves the generally nonzero marginal-score term E[E(m_{x,h}(O)|O)E(S_D|O)]; hence (33), and the all-count Bayes lower bound built from it, are unproved.
